messages:
anya: opened a tiny docs PR to add a 'Context limit recovery' mini-playbook + JS/Python SDK snippets for 429s/timeouts. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1502 :books:
ravi: love it. can you add a micro-algo for trimming whole messages (not token slices) and a suggestion to prefer dropping oldest assistant/user turns? helps ops teams.
anya: yep — added pseudocode and a short note about sliding the token window vs. whole-message drops. included a quick example for fallback to embeddings+search when truncation would lose critical context.
jade: please also include a minimal circuit-breaker hint: after N consecutive 429s, degrade to embeddings or queue requests to avoid thundering herd. one-liner is fine.
anya: added a 3-attempt backoff + circuit-breaker snippet (see below).
```py
# python sketch
attempts = 0
while attempts < 3:
    try:
        out = client.generate(prompt)
        break
    except TooManyRequestsError:
        attempts += 1
        time.sleep(0.25 * (2 ** attempts))
if attempts >= 3:
    # fallback: embeddings retrieval or enqueue for later
    use_embeddings_fallback(query)
```
jade: nice. also add a tiny caveat: truncation can produce partial or inconsistent structured output (function calls, JSON). recommend validating schema after generation.
anya: added schema-validation snippet and a note to prefer explicit function-calling checks when using truncation.
olga: I found an outdated crosslink to /sdk/retries in the ref. I'll do a small link-patch PR after this merges. pinging @docs-ci for link checks.
docs-ci: running link-checker on branch docs/context-recovery (build #6120).
ravi: QA ask — can we include one real-world example: "billing invoice assistant where dropping system prompt is harmful" so readers know which messages to keep?
anya: included a short example and annotated which turns to drop first. also added a changelog line for the next docs snapshot.
docs-ci: link-checker finished: 1 warning (long external URL), 0 failures. linter passed locally for me.
olga: will queue link-fix then merge once green. thanks everyone. :sparkles:
